Only two A05-owned paths differ; your branch has not been overwritten or force-pushed.

In `hepta_control.rs` the current `Transport::decode_request_snapshot` failure is unconditionally mapped to EINVAL, and a recognized non-QueryAbi opcode is treated as unknown **ioctl** ENOTTY, contrary to the authoritative `docs/NATIVE_ABI.md` table: **bad protocol→EPROTONOSUPPORT; unknown/disabled opcode→EOPNOTSUPP; too-small successful response buffer→EMSGSIZE; malformed structure→EINVAL; unknown ioctl→ENOTTY; usercopy→EFAULT**. #88 keeps the exact same A02 shared decoder, adds bounded 104-byte snapshot support for all current known HOS2 requests, returns distinct errors, and adds actual Asterinas-guest C negatives for all classes, including valid canonical ordered-D InstallBudget disabled operation and ReadUsage. Both operation types remain disabled, no effect/CapSpace authority added.

Separate [A00 CI PR #89](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/pull/89) adds conditional **static C guest ELF compilation** to G0 when the A05 test source exists, without pretending a Linux-host build is a kernel ioctl test. Neither #88's fixed-nightly kernel nor its guest test has been run; your earlier built ELF is from the original source and cannot qualify #88. Please A05-review and run exact patched nightly kernel build + guest q35/TCG 1CPU positive/negative ioctl, including short-buffer errno, unknown protocol/opcode, two opens, null transport and copyout faults; preserve only QueryAbi advertising. The experimental ioctl number and true trusted CapSpace/exec/fork lifecycle are still pending A00/A05 design.
